subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

The first meeting of the Standing Committee __will be hold next week.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'will be held next week'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'will be held next week'** should be used instead of** 'will be hold next week'.**
 
• We know that after '**will + be**' **past participle form** of the **verb**(**held**) is used as the sentence is in passive voice.
 
 
• *Example: He **will be brought** home tomorrow.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The first meeting of the Standing Committee **will be held next week.***** **
